result.evidence_quote: These findings highlight spatially localized cytotoxic cell exhaustion as a key immune evasion mechanism in HPV-negative HNSCC and underscore the value of integrating spatial and single-cell data to reveal therapeutic vulnerabilities.
result.rationale: The study directly addresses cancer progression through tumor-specific immune changes and cytotoxic cell exhaustion, identifying immune evasion mechanisms and potential therapeutic vulnerabilities in HPV-negative HNSCC.
